title: GzDRL: Reproducible and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning with Gazebo
abstract: arXiv:2609.13243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present GzDRL, a novel single-process reinforcement learning (RL) framework for Gazebo that overcomes longstanding bottlenecks in scalable, reproducible robotics experimentation. Unlike conventional middleware-based RL-Gazebo integrations that suffer from nondeterminism and irreproducibility, GzDRL introduces a systematic, middleware-free environment-stepping mechanism that directly synchronizes agent actions and physics updates. This design enables deterministic, high-throughput data collection, efficient vectorization, and reproducible RL training and evaluation. Comprehensive benchmarks demonstrate that GzDRL achieves the highest workstation throughput among the evaluated frameworks while remaining competitive with GPU-accelerated simulators on laptop hardware, and maintains precise agent-environment synchronization, multi-agent scalability, and experiment-level reproducibility. translated_title: GzDRL：基于Gazebo的可复现且可扩展的深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GzDRL，这是一种面向Gazebo的新型单进程强化学习（RL）框架，克服了机器人实验中可扩展性与可复现性方面的长期瓶颈。与基于中间件的传统RL-Gazebo集成方式（存在非确定性和不可复现的问题）不同，GzDRL引入了一种系统性的无中间件环境步进机制，可直接同步智能体动作与物理更新。这一设计实现了确定性的高吞吐量数据采集、高效的向量化以及可复现的强化学习训练与评估。全面的基准测试表明，GzDRL在所评估的框架中实现了最高的工作站吞吐量，同时在笔记本电脑硬件上与GPU加速模拟器相比仍具竞争力，并保持了精确的智能体-环境同步、多智能体可扩展性以及实验级别的可复现性。我们进一步通过部署验证了仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的迁移能力。
tldr: GzDRL是一个面向Gazebo的无中间件单进程强化学习框架，通过直接同步智能体动作与物理更新，实现了确定性、高吞吐量和可复现的机器人强化学习实验。
en_tdlr: GzDRL is a middleware-free single-process reinforcement learning framework for Gazebo that achieves deterministic, high-throughput, and reproducible robotics RL experiments by directly synchronizing agent actions with physics updates.
